bullets: The thinker agent now runs on GPT-5.6 Luna with maximum reasoning, replacing its previous Gemini-based model.
Hosted desktop sessions now stay open for up to 15 minutes of inactivity before being reclaimed, up from 10 minutes.
Legacy Desktop clients now see a clear update-required message instead of a misleading model-unavailable error.
The spend unit label changed from tokens to model spend, showing dollar costs rounded to cents when enabled by operators.
The Freebuff Pro house ad now uses after-hours themed visuals and price-driven messaging about paid subscription benefits.
The DeepSeek model in the picker is now labeled V4.1 Flash and can process images directly instead of just describing them.
Desktop purchase pauses now block new purchases with a clear refusal message when paused, rather than charging users.
Pinned desktop tabs now keep their session identity during end or refund requests, preventing duplicate actions on retry.
